articles.title: Alcaraz's 3:34 AM Loss — and the Grin That Said Everything
articles.summary: Carlos Alcaraz lost a five-set thriller at 3:34 AM — the latest finish in US Open history. But after five months out with a wrist injury, he walked off smiling.

articles.title: Lancaster, PA: The U.S. Capital You've Never Heard Of (It Lasted One Day)
articles.summary: In September 1777, Lancaster, Pennsylvania, served as the U.S. capital for a single day before Congress fled west from the advancing British army. Now it celebrates with an annual Capital Day.

articles.title: Robert Eggers' 'Werwulf' Promises His Darkest Film Yet — Plus an Interactive Game
articles.summary: Robert Eggers' new werewolf film 'Werwulf' hits theaters December 25. Set in a 13th-century English village, it stars Aaron Taylor-Johnson and comes with a new trailer and interactive game.
